parent: v18 early localized evidence-conflict repair, itself an exact-abort descendant of v15 tau=0.004

one_change.unchanged: retain v15 admissible early abort, the two horizontal trajectories, vertical commit evidence, one bidirectionally selected conflict block, full-draft repair verification, and prompt-visible code guard
one_change.problem: v18 re-masks every fast/accuracy disagreement in its selected block, including tokens that both external full-draft contexts already support for the selected parent
one_change.sparse_frontier: within that one block, preserve a parent token only when it has strictly higher log probability than the alternative under both complete external draft contexts; re-mask every other disagreement
one_change.no_new_threshold: the rule uses sign agreement only and introduces no tuned scalar or task-conditioned branch

thought_axes.vertical: the admissible bound and path-time commit evidence decide whether a completed accuracy trajectory can still matter
thought_axes.horizontal: two complete drafts localize a conflict and require cross-context unanimity before a parent token becomes immutable
thought_axes.error_control: the repair cannot rewrite a disagreement already supported for the parent by both full-draft contexts

generation_inputs_allowed: fast and non-aborted accuracy trajectory tokens

data_lineage.implementation_and_rule: frozen before any v18 or v19 result is available

activation: run only after the already queued fair v15-or-v18 reproduction finishes and only when v18 is not accepted

rapid_gates.code_parallel: HumanEval-164 must strictly beat v15 and MBPP-100 must be non-regressive; each task NFE no more than 1.05x v15
rapid_gates.reasoning_parallel: MATH-50 and GSM8K-64 must be non-regressive individually and strictly improve in aggregate over v15; each task NFE no more than 1.05x v15
rapid_gates.formal: one profile across all four full benchmarks; no task regression, strict aggregate accuracy gain, clean IDs/hashes/masks/NFE/leakage/model-input audits

fallback: retain the already fair-audited v18 if accepted, otherwise retain v15 when any v19 gate fails
freeze_contract: freeze source hashes and queue contract before any v19 model stage; never use formal suffix correctness to revise the rule
